description: Canonical feature flag key names and default values, sourced from packages/shared/src/feature-flags.ts. Keys are camelCase. Defaults are the fallback when the backend is unreachable and the initial static backend response. Flag values are backend-managed (admin.setFeatureFlag); clients never persist flag changes locally as authoritative.

flags.description: Live location sharing and map markers.
Kronjakt geographic point hunt (hand-placed, admin-approved reward points).

Kronjakt AUTOMATIC crown spawning: the scheduled spawner, the aggregate activity signal collected from live-location updates, and crownHunt.claimSpawn. Default OFF — a hand-placed point carries a named admin's safe-location confirmation for that exact spot and an auto-spawned crown cannot, so the automatic engine stays dark until it is deliberately enabled AND admins have approved the areas it may place in (crownSpawnCells, via crownHunt.setSpawnCellApproval). Turning it off stops spawning and stops collecting the activity signal immediately; already-placed crowns still age off the map via the sweep. Independent of crownHunt, so the curated points are unaffected either way.
Anonymous partner pass-by statistics (requires explicit user opt-in regardless of flag).
Sharing content to external social platforms.

Anonymous partner pass-by interaction recording (Phase 9j privacy gate). Default OFF; contributions additionally require the user's explicit anonymousPartnerStatsOptIn — the flag alone never enables recording.
